CLM-2027-00201.rationale: Engine damage resulting from water ingression/hydrostatic lock is excluded without the Engine & Gearbox Protection endorsement (IMT-29), which is not on file.

CLM-2027-00202.rationale: The claim covers straightforward own-damage repairs to the rear bumper and taillight from a parking collision. Since this is not a glass-only claim, the standard excess of ₹1,000 applies.

CLM-2027-00203.rationale: Earthquake damage is not covered under the standard home policy without an Earthquake Extension endorsement (IAP-01). As no such endorsement is on file, the claim is denied.

CLM-2027-00201.rationale: Engine damage resulting from water ingression (hydrostatic lock) is excluded under standard motor coverage without the Engine & Gearbox Protection endorsement (IMT-29). As no such endorsement is active on this policy, the claim is denied.

CLM-2027-00202.rationale: The own-damage claim for bumper and taillight repairs following a collision with a pillar is covered under the motor policy. Payout is calculated as the claimed amount of ₹18,000 less the compulsory deductible of ₹1,000.
